description: This file defines a 'Loader' component using LightningJS, which displays animated circles to indicate loading status. It includes component properties, state management, lifecycle hooks, and animation methods.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A LightningJS component that displays animated circles as a loading indicator.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins a cyclic animation that toggles the 'alpha' state to create a fade-in and fade-out effect on the circles.
